story_facts_verified.project: One Twenty Vine, a proposed two-building, 242-unit apartment development in the Arena District, Columbus.
story_facts_verified.address: 154 Vine Street, to be readdressed 120 Vine Street after combining nine parcels plus portions of surrounding right-of-way; block bounded by Vine, Spruce, Armstrong and Kilbourne streets.
story_facts_verified.design: Two seven-story buildings (five floors of wood framing over a two-story podium; parapet just over 83 feet); residential only, no retail; ground-floor leasing office, fitness center and resident lounge; 56 enclosed first-floor parking spaces and 10 bicycle spaces; third-floor skywalk to the Kilbourne Garage; shared interior courtyard with a pool deck.
story_facts_verified.team: Development partner Nationwide Realty Investors (development arm of Nationwide Insurance); owner HP Land Development LTD (a Hamilton Parker affiliate); architect The Columbus Architectural Studio.
story_facts_verified.status: Columbus Downtown Commission approved the design September 22, 2026; building permits still required; no construction timeline, rents or affordability set-aside announced.
story_facts_verified.related_project: Two Twenty Vine, a 124-unit apartment building immediately west at 220 Vine Street by the same partnership; its multifamily new-structure permit was issued 2023-12-05 (confirmed in the City of Columbus Building Permits dataset).
story_facts_verified.primary_record_check: City of Columbus Building Permits (CC0, ArcGIS feature service), pulled 2026-10-01: a search for 154/120 Vine Street returned only a 2014 electrical permit and a 2021 commercial MEP permit -- no new-structure permit -- consistent with a project that has cleared design review but not filed for construction. The same dataset returned '220 VINE ST | Multi Family - New Structure | 2023-12-05 | 124 units', corroborating Two Twenty Vine.
story_facts_verified.geography: Site, Two Twenty Vine, and Nationwide Arena geocoded from OpenStreetMap (ODbL) on 2026-10-01 for the locator map: 154 Vine St 39.9714988,-83.0080316; 220 Vine St 39.9719370,-83.0084582; Nationwide Arena 39.9691873,-83.0060800.
story_facts_verified.original_contributions: Direct public-records check of the City of Columbus Building Permits dataset (site permit status and the neighboring Two Twenty Vine permit/unit count); a CREN locator map placing the site in its Arena District context; and the Two Twenty Vine -> One Twenty Vine comparison showing the block-by-block Vine Street infill pattern.
story_facts_verified.limitations_stated: The Downtown Commission's own minutes for the September 22, 2026 meeting were not posted on columbus.gov as of this run (materials listed only through December 16, 2025), so the vote is sourced to two independent news accounts rather than a primary city document; no construction timeline, rents or affordability set-aside announced; courtyard and amenity details come from the applicant's submitted plans as described in the coverage.
